summary:
Fully hardened AURA Supabase Implementation Plan with all mandatory corrections:
1. Sequence-backed Order ID generation: Uses full sequence value `AURA-YYMM-SEQ` (e.g. AURA-2611-10001) ensuring uniqueness well beyond 10,000 orders without modulo wraparound.
2. Hardened idempotency & request fingerprinting: Stores sha256 checkout payload fingerprint; rejects reuse of key with changed payload; verifies existing order belongs to auth.uid(); checks legitimate retry before applying order rate-limits.
3. Strict checkout validation: Non-empty array, integer bounds (1..10 per line, 1..20 per product-size), verifies published status, size in product.sizes, color in product.colors; preserves color in order_items; validates name, phone, street, city, and courier (Pathao Express, RedX, Steadfast); strictly validates payment method against storefront_settings; safe fallback defaults if aura_main_config is missing; aura_main_config explicitly seeded.
4. Backend checkout proxy & anti-abuse: Express endpoint `/api/checkout` with express-rate-limit IP throttling and Cloudflare Turnstile / CAPTCHA verification, forwarding authenticated user's Supabase JWT to `place_order_atomic`; direct public/anon access revoked.
5. Order cancellation: Granted exclusively to `service_role`; allowed transitions defined (pending, confirmed, processing, packed, shipped -> cancelled; delivered orders rejected); validates inventory rows exist before marking cancelled; restores inventory in deterministic sorted order exactly once; fully atomic.
6. Database privileges & RLS: Explicit GRANT and REVOKE for every table; removed self-referencing profiles policy; customers can only UPDATE full_name and phone via column-level privileges; orders, order_items, product_inventory, CMS, and admin tables strictly write-protected from client-side direct access.
7. Storefront settings protection: Public SELECT on storefront_settings table removed; public view `public.v_public_storefront_settings` exposes only safe public fields; unpublished policies and private contacts remain hidden.
8. size_guides.is_published FALSE by default: Admin must explicitly verify and publish measurement data; zero invented measurements.
9. Concurrency-safe recently-viewed pruning: Per-user advisory lock `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('rv_' || NEW.user_id))` inside trigger keeping newest 20 items.
10. Customer Auth: Preserves Email/Password authentication and supports anonymous sessions with account linking (`supabase.auth.linkIdentity()`).
11. Assets & Content: Verifies all original assets exist; preserves original hero text ("GIVES YOU DIFFERENT VIBE"), announcements, ৳100 shipping fee, ৳3,000 threshold, and courier options.
12. Comprehensive Node.js automated test suite covering all 13 specified security and edge cases.
